flags.message: The fixed term stated is twelve months (s4), but the commencement and expiry dates do not span exactly 12 months (2026-10-01 to 2027-08-31); the expiry date is less than 12 full months from commencement.
The stated annual rent (QAR 100,000, s5) does not align with the stated monthly rent (QAR 8,500, s5); multiplying monthly rent by 12 gives 102,000 which differs from the stated annual rent.
Termination terms specify 60 days written notice subject to fixed term (s9), which creates some ambiguity if termination can occur during fixed term period or only after.

segments.text: FICTIONAL RESIDENTIAL LEASE FOR SOFTWARE EVALUATION ONLY
This agreement is made between Marina Crest Holdings W.L.L. as landlord and Example Tenant Two as tenant.
The premises are unit MC-B-1204 at Marina Crest Residences, Tower B, Lusail.
The fixed term is twelve months. Commencement is 1 October 2026 and the last inclusive day is 31 August 2027.
The tenant shall pay QAR 8,500 each month. The stated annual rent is QAR 100,000.
A security deposit of QAR 3,000 is due before handover.
On each annual renewal the monthly rent shall be changed as mutually agreed.
A renewal request must be received in writing 60 days before expiry and any renewal lasts twelve months.
Either party must give 60 days written notice for termination subject to the fixed term.
All parties and signatures in this sample are fictional.
